description: This Java source file defines a test assertion class 'ThingModifyCommandResponseAssert' used for verifying properties of 'ThingModifyCommandResponse' objects in unit tests. It provides fluent API methods for asserting the resource path, headers, status, and entity of a command response, utilizing the AssertJ assertion library.

classes.name: ThingModifyCommandResponseAssert
